checks: The cited volume-root argument applies to one step by midpoint containment (K_z+K_{p_[z]})/2⊆K_{R(z)} and Brunn–Minkowski. The full-path formula has a terminal witness target, but its convexity and volume argument already works at this intermediate midpoint, so 2f(R(z))≥f(z)+f(p_[z]). At a root g is exactly zero. All fibers in this step are nonempty, including null fibers.

Substituting f(z_j)=2f(z_{j+1})−f(p_[z_j])−g(z_j) gives the dyadic recurrence with correct signs. At a root k=0 gives a terminal coefficient one and no digits or slack. Equal f(p_r)=f₀ yields sum of slack weights f₀−f(z) between zero and f₀.

Finite weighted summation gives the asserted A_w with nonnegative coefficients. Each path has coefficient sum 2^k−(2^k−1)=1. Replacing scalar f with vector bases and dropping g gives the exact first moment from the affine recurrence, without a restriction on rank or positive fiber volumes.

In one dimension, for roots 0 and 1 the two coefficient moments force C_w(1)=Σ_{z=0}^L z=L(L+1)/2 and C_w(0)=(L+1)(1−L/2), which is negative for every integer L>2. Independently iterating exact integer coefficients for L=1,…,32 reproduced both formulas.

The l₁ polyhedron has the sign rows Σ_i ε_i(z_i−1/2)≤n/2 for ε_i∈{−1,1}; every binary root is tight at exactly its own row, and at an integer z the sum of absolute distances is at least n/2 with equality exactly at binary roots. This verifies exclusivity, full dimension and lattice avoidance, including n=1; an independent integer check for n=1,…,4 confirms the sign patterns.

The product C=[0,L]^n×K has actual projection [0,L]^n and K in every sampled fiber, so all midpoint slacks vanish. The actual volumes sum to (L+1)^n|K|_d and 2^n|K|_d at roots, giving a divergent ratio for fixed n≥1 and any d≥1.
